mainEntity.name: Can I reuse the same AI marketing prompts for different brands or business ideas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not assume that a prompt or bot will work equally well across businesses. Run My AI Biz’s master prompts are intended to be customized for your niche, audience, offer, voice, objectives, and approval requirements. Key factors include differences in customer intent, product complexity, platform rules, source material, and brand positioning. Keep separate instructions and source libraries for separate businesses or projects. Test each adaptation with representative content before reusing it. Run My AI Biz presents the resource collection as adaptable blueprints, not guaranteed plug-and-play businesses.
